classifications.rationale: The President makes a present statutory determination selecting which divided-commissioner findings constitute the ITC's determinations; the referenced safeguard implementation was separately accomplished by the Proclamation.
classifications.evidence: I have determined, pursuant to section 330(d)(1) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended, to consider the determinations of the groups of commissioners voting in the affirmative with regard to tin mill products and stainless steel wire to be the determination of the ITC

classifications.rationale: The President presently establishes specified tariff increases and a tariff-rate quota, directly fixing legally consequential import duties and quota levels.
classifications.evidence: I have established the following safeguard measures

classifications.rationale: The President makes the relevant statutory finding and presently exempts specified countries and qualifying products from the safeguard measures.
classifications.evidence: the safeguard measure will not apply to imports of certain flat steel, hot-rolled bar, cold-finished bar, rebar, certain tubular products, carbon and alloy fittings, stainless steel bar, stainless steel rod, tin mill products, and stainless steel wire that are the product of Canada or Mexico

classifications.rationale: The segment inseparably combines a present presidential designation of beneficiary countries as developing countries with internal monitoring and consultation instructions to the USTR.
classifications.evidence: I determine that the beneficiary countries under the Generalized System of Preferences are developing countries

classifications.rationale: The segment combines present product exclusions, discretionary delegations, mandatory later agency determinations and legal modifications, consultations and reporting, and required regulations establishing licensing and duty-deposit administration.
classifications.evidence: I have also determined to exclude from these safeguard measures the steel products listed in the subsequent clauses of subdivision (b) of Note 11 in the Annex to the Proclamation.

classifications.rationale: The President makes the statutory benefit-cost and adjustment finding supporting the safeguard measures, a present legally operative determination under the governing safeguard framework.
classifications.evidence: I have determined that the safeguard measures will facilitate efforts by the domestic industries to make a positive adjustment to import competition

classifications.rationale: This conditional clause contemplates a future presidential determination but neither makes that determination nor itself changes the safeguard measures or dictates a legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: If I determine that further action is appropriate and feasible

classifications.rationale: The provision requires the President, upon a future statutory determination, to produce a specified later legal consequence by reducing, modifying, or terminating the safeguards; it also prescribes factors for that determination.
classifications.evidence: I shall reduce, modify, or terminate the safeguard measures
